Sandbox_AmmoMaking_QualityTracking: Track ammunition quality in magazines and firearms (experimental)
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_QualityTracking_toolt: EXPERIMENTAL, single player only. The casing quality of handloaded rounds is kept when they are loaded into a magazine or firearm, and given back when they are unloaded. It has no effect on firing. Not yet verified in game.
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_QualityEffects_toolti: EXPERIMENTAL, single player only, needs quality tracking on as well. A load of poor handloaded rounds raises the gun's own jam chance a little after each shot, in proportion to how poor it is; good handloads and factory rounds add nothing. Damage, range and accuracy are never changed. Not yet verified in game.
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_ServerAuthority: Multiplayer: the server performs sampling, assays, the analyzer and mining (experimental)
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_ServerAuthority_toolt: EXPERIMENTAL, multiplayer only, not yet verified on a server. Off: on a multiplayer server, digging samples, the assay kits, the laboratory analyzer and mining stay refused. On: clients ask, the server checks distance, tools and items and does the work, and every player sees the same deposits. No effect in single player.
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_DepositReserveMultipl: Scales how many ore units a copper or zinc deposit tile holds. 1 is the mod's balance. Every workable grade keeps at least one unit, and trace ground stays empty. Tiles already worked keep what was taken from them.
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_DieSetLootMultiplier: Die sets and bullet moulds found as loot (multiplier)
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_DieSetLootMultiplier_: Scales how often die sets and bullet moulds turn up in gun stores, garage gun lockers and among a hunter's things. 1 is the mod's balance, 0 takes them out of loot (they can still be forged). Containers already filled keep what they hold. The sandbox's tool loot setting scales them too.
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_ComponentLootMultipli: Scales how often the gunpowder, loose primers, brass scrap and small brass sheets the mod adds to loot turn up. 1 is the mod's balance, 0 takes them out. Containers already filled keep what they hold.
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_XPMultiplier_tooltip: The Ammo Making skill's own XP multiplier, like the game's per-skill multipliers. Like them, it is used only when the global XP multiplier is switched off; otherwise the global one applies. Recycling teaches nothing at any value.
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_TreatmentBonusMultipl: Scales the quality that lubing cast bullets with candle wax, annealing cases with a blowtorch and cleaning spent cases with steel wool add. 1 is the mod's balance, 0 makes them worthless. Items already finished keep their quality.
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_RegrindLossMultiplier: Scales how much each regrind lowers the condition a worn die set can be brought back to. 1 is the mod's balance (two points a regrind); higher wears die sets out sooner. Always at least one point.
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_ExtraJamMultiplier: Extra jam chance of poor handloads (multiplier)
Sandbox_AmmoMaking_ExtraJamMultiplier_to: Only with the experimental option 'Poor handloads jam more often'. Scales the largest extra jam chance a load of the worst handloads adds (4 percentage points at 1).
